{{Quote|The production of bacta&mdash;literally the brewing together of alazhi and kavam&mdash;appears to produce an almost mystical amount of satisfaction for the Vratix.|[[Winter Celchu]] during her briefing of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] prior to the [[Bacta War]].|<ref name="Bacta War">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>}}
'''Alazhi''' was a [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]] grown on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. It was one of the two components vital to creation of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]. Over half of the planet Thyferra was dedicated to expansive paddies growing alazhi, with further production occurring on planets including [[Verkuyl]].

==Description==
Alazhi,<ref name="Bacta" /> also known as alayhi salve,<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a lotion used by the [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] on [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] to treat cuts and burns. It was one of the main components in the creation of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], combined with the liquid chemical called [[kavam]].<ref name="Bacta" /> A [[Bone/Legends|bone]] [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Bacteria/Legends|bacterium]], Alazhi was cultured within [[xoorzi]] [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]]; large paddies of xoorzi fungus covered over half of Thyferra's planetary surface. Alazhi was primarily produced on Thyferra,<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> but it was also cultivated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Verkuyl]] where two whole continents were given over to growing the substance.<ref name="Conflict">{{JournalCite|13|Conflict of Interest}}</ref> [[Zaltin Corporation]] controlled over four hundred planets for the cultivation of alazhi.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], bacta prices skyrocketed when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] falsified a report on an alazhi shortage.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|18|alazhi}}</ref>
